fieldCodes.invalid_json: The request body is not valid JSON.

fieldCodes.invalid_object: Enter an object with the expected fields.

fieldCodes.too_small: Enter a value of at least {{min}}.
fieldCodes.too_large: Enter a value of at most {{max}}.
fieldCodes.datetime_out_of_range: Enter a date and time between {{min}} and {{max}}.
fieldCodes.out_of_range: This request contains a date or number that is out of range.
fieldCodes.unstorable_value: This request contains a value that cannot be stored.
fieldCodes.line_breaks: Enter this on one line, without line breaks or tabs.
fieldCodes.invalid_domain: Enter a domain name such as example.com.
fieldCodes.invalid_phone: Enter a phone number using digits, spaces and + ( ) - . / only.
fieldCodes.invalid_timezone: Choose a timezone from the list, for example Asia/Amman.
fieldCodes.duplicates: Remove the values that appear more than once.
fieldCodes.end_before_start: The end date must not be before the start date.
fieldCodes.not_found: The selected item does not exist.
fieldCodes.host_must_be_self: You can only invite visitors you host yourself.
fieldCodes.visitor_required: Choose an existing visitor or enter the visitor's details.
fieldCodes.visitor_both: Provide either an existing visitor or new visitor details, not both.
fieldCodes.end_not_after_start: The end time must be after the start time.
fieldCodes.visit_too_long_one: A visit can last at most {{count}} hour.
fieldCodes.visit_too_long_other: A visit can last at most {{count}} hours.
fieldCodes.end_in_past: The end time must not be in the past.
fieldCodes.start_in_past: The start time must not be in the past.
fieldCodes.too_far_ahead_one: A visit can be scheduled at most {{count}} day ahead.
fieldCodes.too_far_ahead_other: A visit can be scheduled at most {{count}} days ahead.
fieldCodes.range_too_long_one: Choose a range of at most {{count}} day.
fieldCodes.range_too_long_other: Choose a range of at most {{count}} days.
fieldCodes.expected_end_in_past: The expected end must be in the future.
fieldCodes.check_out_before_check_in: The check-out time must not be before the check-in time.
fieldCodes.check_out_in_future: The check-out time must not be in the future.
fieldCodes.walk_in_expected_visit: This visitor has a visit today. Check them in on that visit instead (Expected), after verifying their ID: the lost pass then stops working when they check out.
fieldCodes.walk_in_during_window: This visitor's pass for a visit is valid now. Check them in on that visit instead (Expected), after verifying their ID: the lost pass then stops working when they check out.
fieldCodes.walk_in_before_window: This visitor's pass for a visit becomes valid at {{time}} today. Check them in on that visit from then (Expected), after verifying their ID: a walk-in would leave the lost pass working.
fieldCodes.walk_in_needs_record: A lost pass belongs to a visitor who was invited: select their record as a returning visitor (or check them in from Expected), after verifying their ID, instead of entering new details.
fieldCodes.too_many_reinvitations_one: This visitor has {{count}} scheduled visit. A new email address sends it a new invitation, and at most {{limit}} invitations can be sent per user in 24 hours.
fieldCodes.too_many_reinvitations_other: This visitor has {{count}} scheduled visits. A new email address sends each of them a new invitation, and at most {{limit}} invitations can be sent per user in 24 hours: cancel some of these visits first. Clearing the email address withdraws all their passes at once.
fieldCodes.password_is_email: Password must not be the same as your email address.
fieldCodes.password_common: This password is too common. Choose a less predictable password.
fieldCodes.password_guessable: This password is too easy to guess: it is a common word with numbers or symbols added. Choose a less predictable password.
fieldCodes.password_personal: This password is too easy to guess: it is based on your name, email address or company. Choose a less predictable password.
fieldCodes.password_unchanged: Choose a password that is different from your current password.
fieldCodes.markup_not_allowed: Write plain text: tags and HTML character references are not allowed.

fieldCodes.unknown_placeholder: “{{name}}” is not a variable of this email.
fieldCodes.placeholder_not_allowed: “{{name}}” cannot be used in this text.
fieldCodes.placeholder_repeated_one: Use “{{name}}” only once in this text.
fieldCodes.placeholder_repeated_other: Use “{{name}}” at most {{count}} times in this text.
fieldCodes.invalid_color: Enter a colour as # and six hexadecimal digits in lower case.
fieldCodes.image_too_small: Choose an image of at least {{min_width}} by {{min_height}} pixels.
fieldCodes.image_too_large: Choose an image of at most {{max_width}} by {{max_height}} pixels.
fieldCodes.image_not_square: Choose a square image: its width must equal its height.
